Copy live logits and index/draft-token metadata into fixed buffers; return a fresh clone of the tiny sampled-ID tensor to preserve output storage lifetime.

Prior skip-unused-logprobs trial removed extra saved logits; this candidate preserves even those operations and reduces host submission instead.
